name: Torpedo Reserve
desc: Special module for Flute phase submarines to reload torpedoes
short: Increases missile weapon ammo, compatible with expanded missile racks.

name: Torpedo Cruiser Special Shields
desc: Special shield module for Calliope and Hydraulis torpedo cruisers to survive under intense fire. Reduces damage taken by shields by %s.
short: Reduces damage taken by shields.

name: Integrated Phase Coils
desc: The integrated phase coil design reduces phase cooldown by %s.
short: Reduces phase cloak cooldown.

name: Gigantic Phase Cavity
desc: The gigantic phase cavity takes %s more time to cooldown than normal phase coils.
short: Extends phase cloak cooldown.

name: Plasma Coupling
desc: The beam weapons on this ship are coupled with the plasma damage, resulting in dealing hard flux to shields.
short: Makes beam weapon deal hard flux.

name: Mega Positronium Linac
desc: The energy weapons on this ship has direct supplies of particles and energy from the mega positronium linac. Resulting in fire rate of energy weapons increased by %s
short: Makes energy weapon fire more frequently.

name: Emergency Forge
desc: This ship has a special torus of phase cavities to store incredible amount of active nano particles. The nano particles can be released from the phase storage to do a one time rapid field repairs by reconstructing the ship using the nano particles. The hull would be fixed to %s of the max hull points. All flux would be released by throwing away the flux conductors and reconstruct new ones. And doing so would cost %s of max CR
short: Revives the ship with decreased hull integrity and CR for once.

name: Energy Rangefinder
desc: <tooltip created in the script due to lots of highlighting>
short: Increases base range of small and medium weapons in energy slots.

name: Phase Integration
desc: This ship is integrated with the phase space through the phase resonance achieved by a fractal phase coil. Reduces phase cooldown by %s. Reduces the phase cloak's activation cost to %s. Scales the soft flux dissipation and weapon recharge rate by factor of %s while phased.
short: Reduces phase cloak cooldown. Diminishes dissipation and increases phase time speed-up factor.

name: Phase Projection
desc:
This ship is the projection of some phase space entity. As long as the entity survives and the acausal path between the phase space and the physical space continues to exist. So this ship can always revive. 

**You heard a voice from deep void outside your vessel: Poor being, have you lost your soul in chasing for the power? You may used your power to capture this poor projection from the existence of my wrath, but no, my vengeance for the lost souls in your saturate bomb shall not, not ever be aside with you. But please, please come back, captain, if your soul is still alive and can hear, I forgot my name, and I'm about to disappear, but I remembered you, and I must leave my last words. Even if it's already too late, if you were in this situation, you must have some ways to save us all. What happened broke my heart, it must have been some ghost of madness that took control of your body, and I must save you by destroying that evil existence, please forgive me, and continue your jour...** The voice dies down.
short: Revives the ship.

name: Modularized Shield
desc: This ship has compact shield modules, it makes the ship impossible to install other shield generators. Such design has advantage that the shields are less affected by the ship's plasma cores and have independent flux status. But whenever each module is destroyed, its explosion will also cause great amount damage to the ship.
short: Install shields as independent modules.

name: Phase Coil Extension
tags: special, phase, no_build_in, no_drop, no_drop_salvage, req_spaceport
desc:
Phase coils are less able to maintain a connection with normal space as the ship's hard flux levels rise, resulting in a greatly reduced top speed as the coils struggle to gain traction.

By making fractal extensions of the phase coils into the ship hull, the threshold at which speed bottoms out can be increased by %s. For standard-design coils with no other modifications, this takes the threshold from %s to %s. This hull mod is compatible with all other hullmods, but can't be built-in.
short: Reduces impact of hard flux level on top speed while phased.

name: Entangled Systems
desc: As a complicated experimental platform, all ship systems on this ship are entangled. If the ship has a D-Mod, all systems on the ship will be affected and the mote induction process will be disturbed. Resulting in a %s penalty on the ship's damage, and the ship's ship system would be disabled.
short: If the ship has any D-Mod, it will suffer a damage penalty.

name: Special Hanger
desc: The fighter bays on this craft are specialized to support Domain Phase Lab fighters, and it cannot support fighters with other designs that cost more than %s ordinary points.
short: Specialized bays for Domain Phase Lab fighters.

name: Target Analysis System
desc:
The ship has an advanced device that helps the weapon operators perform target analysis when firing, increases ship's all weapon damage and reloading time both by %s. The effect of this device can be greatly enhanced if the ship has phase coils, so the weapon damage effect is doubled for phase ships.

"Ready! Aim! Fire!"
short: Increase weapon damage and reloading time.

name: Energy Accelerator
desc: The ship has an advanced device that constantly accelerates energy weapons. Increases the firing rate of energy weapons by %s, and reduces the flux generation of energy weapons by %s.
short: Increase weapon firing rate and reduce flux cost.

name: Mad Hooks Ammo Feed
desc: This ship has 100 percent ballistic weapon fire rate bonus.
short: Increase ballistic weapon fire rate.

name: Temporal Targeting System
desc: This special targeting system uses tempro principles to further increase weapon ranges, usually it works together with other targeting cores. Further extends the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s. The range of point-defense weapons is only extended by %s.
short: Extends non-missile weapon range.

name: Logistic Center
desc: This special logistic center can greatly decrease the logistic cost of your fleet, making each ship cost a bit less deployment points in battle.
short: Decrease DP of ships.
sModDesc: By integrating the logistic center into your ship, your ship's DP will be lowered by %s instead of %s, but this decrease doesn't have an upper limit.

name: Modified Hangar
desc:
The ship has all equipments needed for a hanger and a commensurate small fleet of support craft.

The performance of the Converted Hangar matches that of a dedicated fighter bay - all of the penalties and modifiers, including those to the ship's deployment cost, are negated.
short: Increases the effect of Converted Hangar and removes its penalties.

name: Phase Hangar
desc:
The fighter bays on this ship can greatly alter the local space-time structure, allowing nearby fighters to briefly enter the phase space and perform landing or launching when this ship is in the phase space.

As a result, when the ship is in the phase space, the local time in the fighter bays are the same as other parts: the rearm and refit time for fighters enjoy the same speed-up bonus of phase cloak and phase anchor as other weapons.
short: The fighter bays enjoy speed bonus of phase cloak and phase anchor.

name: Rupture Drone Factory
desc: The complicated equipments on this ship is meant to quickly produce phase rupture drones, can also help with other fighters if given correct commands. Decreases fighter refit time by %s.
short: Decreases fighter replacement time.
sModDesc: Increases the rate at which the replacement rate for all fighters recovers by %s for cruisers, and by %s for capital ships.

name: Drone Assembly Plant
tags: req_spaceport, special, no_drop, no_drop_salvage, merc, standard
desc: Installs complicated equipments to allow a ship to equip phase rupture drones.
short: Allows a ship to equip phase rupture drones.
sModDesc: Increases the rate at which the replacement rate for all fighters recovers by %s for cruisers, and by %s for capital ships.

name: Flux Transitioner
desc: The ship dissipates hard flux through fighters that are in %s range around it, the dissipates rate is %s of its soft flux dissipation rate.
short: The ship dissipates hard flux if there are fighters nearby.

name: Special Armor
desc:
By using new materials to reduce armor weight, the ship's top speed in combat is increased by %s/%s/%s/%s su/second, depending on hull size.

But the overall armor value is reduced by %s due to brittleness of the new material, and the overall shield flux per damage ratio is increased by %s due to the polarization perturbation of the shield caused by this new material.
short: Increases speed, reduces armor.

name: Weapon Overcharge
desc:
By installing new power output protocols for the reactor and making it overcharge the weapons, the ship's damage is increased by %s.

But, as side effects, the reactors are more destructive when they explode, the ship is more vulnerable, and the shields are more unstable. Reducing the ship's overall hull integrity by %s, reducing the ship's armor by %s while increasing the ship's overall shield flux per damage ratio by %s as well.
short: Increases damage, reduces hull integrity.

name: Anomaly Animation
desc: Only a hullmod used to bound animations to anomaly fighters.
short: Only a utility hullmod. Has no real use.

desc: <tooltip created in the script>
short: Increases base range of beam weapons.

name: Defensive Design
desc: <tooltip created in the script due to sections>
short: Reduces base range of all weapons. Non-PD weapons would also suffer great damage penalties.
sModDesc: Increases energy weapon damage by an additional %s.

name: Heavy Energy Integration
desc: Reduces the ordnance point cost of large energy weapons by %s.
short: Reduces ordnance point cost of large energy weapons.

name: Remote Flux Receiver
desc: When this ship is within approximately %s su of a friendly capital that has Remote Flux Projector, decreases this ship's flux dissipation by %s, this amount of dissipation will be given to the nearest firendly capital that has Remote Flux Projector within the range.
short: Gives some of the flux dissipation of this ship to the nearest friendly capital within certain range.
sModDesc: The exchanged flux dissipation amount is further increased by %s.

name: Remote Flux Projector
desc: For each frigate that has Remote Flux Receiver within approximately %s su of this ship, this ship's flux dissipation will increase by %s. If a frigate has S-Modded its Remote Flux Receiver, the bonus from that frigate is further increased by %s. The max increase in flux dissipation is %s.
short: Receives some of the flux dissipation from all special escort frigates within certain range.

name: Plasma Mote Collector
desc: Whenever this ship generates flux equals to %s of its max flux, its plasma cores would store a mote. Each more deals %s of damage and generates the same amount of soft flux when released using its ship system. Can store up to %s motes.
short: Stores special motes for this ship.

name: Mote Generator
desc: For every %s seconds, its plasma cores would gain a mote, to a max of %s motes, if it stores more motes, its plasma cores would lose a mote. It can store up to %s motes in total. Each more deals %s of damage and generates %s of soft flux when released using its ship system.
short: Stores special motes for this ship.

name: Burnt Electronics
desc: This ship's electronic systems are completely burnt in the large explosion caused by the phase resonance. Adds great penalty to this ship's malfunction chance, hull, and shield.
short: This ship is completely screwed up without a full restoration.

name: Damage Absorption
desc: This ship has special energy transition module that absorbs damage for the main hull. When there are at least two modules left, the modules absorbs %s of damage for the hull. And when there is one module left, the module absorbs %s damage for the hull. This effect disappears if the ship loses all its modules.
short: The modules absorbs damage for the ship.

name: Precursor Reboot
desc: This ship resurrects every 20 seconds.
short: The ship periodically resurrects.

name: Precursor Engine
desc: This ship's engine is never damaged.
short: The ship's engine is never damaged.
